description: Defines the GraphFunction class for Torch JIT, including methods for execution, graph management, and optimization within the Torch JIT compiler.

classes.name: GraphFunction
classes.description: Represents a JIT graph-based function with execution and optimization capabilities.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the graph function with a given stack.

methods.name: optimized_graph
methods.description: Returns the optimized version of the graph.

methods.name: qualname
methods.description: Returns the qualified name of the function.

methods.name: _set_initial_executor_execution_mode
methods.description: Sets the initial execution mode (private API).

methods.name: _set_ignore_amp
methods.description: Sets whether to ignore AMP pass (private API).

methods.name: ensure_defined
methods.description: Ensures the function is defined, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: num_inputs
methods.description: Returns the number of inputs to the graph.

methods.name: getDebugState
methods.description: Returns the debug state of the executor.

methods.name: is_optimized
methods.description: Deprecated method that always returns true.

methods.name: check_single_output
methods.description: Checks that the graph has a single output.

methods.name: get_executor
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the graph executor.

methods.name: call
methods.description: Calls the function with a given stack and optional bailout.

methods.name: currentSpecialization
methods.description: Determines the current specialization key based on execution mode.
